## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `CRITERION_HINT` should be fixed before merge: under the `require_shall` validator option, which this pull request keeps, it tells users to write criteria that the validator rejects.

## Changes
This pull request rewords `CRITERION_HINT` to ask for direct action bullets without "shall", and rewords `BULLET_HINT` to show the exact `- ` prefix. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the hint match the require_shall option — With `require_shall=True`, a user who follows the new hint and writes `- Save the result` is rejected, because `accepts_criterion` returns `" shall " in text` (`app/criteria.py:8`). `tests/test_criteria.py:20-21` asserts this rejection, and `config.example.yml:1` exposes the option. — Deployments that enable `require_shall` reject every criterion written as the hint instructs, and the hint gives users no way to recover. — Fix: Choose the hint based on `require_shall`, or word it neutrally so it does not forbid "shall".
